description: A single drum sample player with a decay envelope and a tuning input, in 2HP

params.text: Sets the playback level, 0 to 100%, or the accented level instead when 'Level knob controls Accent' is ticked
Sets how long the sample takes to fade away, 1ms to 10 seconds; fully clockwise there is no decay envelope at all
Tunes the sample up or down two octaves, in semitones
Plays the sample backwards, from its end towards its start

inputs.text: A trigger here plays the sample from the beginning
Held above 1V as TRG fires, the accented level is used for that hit
Lengthens the decay by one second per volt, added to the DEC knob
Raises the playback pitch one octave per volt, multiplying whatever the TUN knob sets

outputs.text: The sample at the level and pitch set, shaped by the decay

notes: nothing plays until a sample is loaded: right-click the panel and use Load Sample, or right-click the display area.
menu: Level knob controls Accent — makes the LVL knob set the accented level rather than the standard one
Logarithmic Decay — uses a logarithmic decay curve instead of an exponential one
Select Samples Root — picks a folder, after which a Samples Browser submenu appears for loading
Interpolation: None, Linear 1, Linear 2, Hermite — chooses how the sample is read between points, which matters when the file's sample rate differs from Rack's or the speed is not 100%
Anti-aliasing filter — adds two-times oversampling and a 20kHz lowpass before the output
Store Sample in Patch — saves the loaded sample inside the patch file, which can make it very large
Tips — a submenu that only prints a reminder that the decay knob fully clockwise turns the decay off

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.3: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
